entities.summary: David Murray, 2nd Earl of Mansfield, 7th Viscount of Stormont, known as the Viscount of Stormont from 1748 to 1793, was a British diplomat and politician. He succeeded to both the Mansfield and Stormont lines of the Murray family, inheriting two titles and two fortunes.
